title: On the Token Collapse Phenomenon in Textual Graph Soft Prompting
abstract: arXiv:2610.31572v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent methods for injecting graph structure into LLM prompts include graph soft prompting, in which a graph neural network (GNN) learns graph-specific tokens that capture relational information among entities in textual prompts. G-Retriever combines graph soft prompts with a verbalized description of the same graph to strengthen the textual prompt signal. We conduct an in-depth analysis of G-Retriever and uncover a pathological behavior we term token collapse. Across three benchmarks, three graph encoders, two LLM families, and both frozen and LoRA-adapted models, G-Retriever's graph tokens become almost indistinguishable across inputs. We provide evidence that the same failure is inherited by subsequent methods, even with multi-token pooling. Under the standard setup, swapping a token with the dataset mean, a token from another example, or one derived from a corrupted graph produces no resolved answer-level effect in accuracy. Moreover

translated_title: 论文：文本图软提示中的词元坍缩现象
translated_abstract: 近期将图结构注入大语言模型（LLM）提示的方法包括图软提示，即由图神经网络（GNN）学习图特定的词元，用以捕获文本提示中实体之间的关系信息。G-Retriever将图软提示与同一图的言语化描述相结合，以增强文本提示信号。我们对G-Retriever进行了深入分析，发现了一种我们称之为“词元坍缩”的病态行为。在三个基准数据集、三种图编码器、两个LLM系列，以及冻结模型和LoRA适配模型上，G-Retriever的图词元在不同输入之间几乎变得无法区分。我们提供证据表明，即使采用多词元池化，后续方法也继承了同样的失败模式。在标准设置下，将某个词元替换为数据集均值词元、来自其他样本的词元，或由损坏的图导出的词元，均不会在准确率上产生答案层面的显著效果。
tldr: 该论文揭示了图软提示方法G-Retriever存在“词元坍缩”病态现象——图词元在不同输入间几乎无法区分且对答案准确率无实际影响，并通过大量实验证明这一缺陷被后续方法普遍继承。
en_tdlr: This paper uncovers a pathological "token collapse" phenomenon in graph soft prompting methods such as G-Retriever, where graph tokens become nearly indistinguishable across inputs and have no meaningful impact on answer accuracy, a flaw that is inherited by subsequent methods.
